Title: CxWorkflowView does not persist commissioning work
Evidence: src/components/CxWorkflowView.tsx header: "Zero API calls. Pure client-side commissioning engine."
Impact: Commissioning manager's Scope/Matrix/Packs/Execute/Deficiencies/Turnover work is lost on browser-clear and invisible to the team
Recommended Fix: Route each CxWorkflow collection through /api/v1/commissioning/*; define missing endpoints for matrix/executions/deficiencies/turnover

Title: Test suite: 1037 failing / 4791 passing
Evidence: Reproduced: npm test -- --run → Test Files 49 failed | 123 passed (172); Tests 1037 failed | 4791 passed (5828)
Impact: CHANGELOG 'green tests' claim is false; no regression signal currently exists
Recommended Fix: Fix React hooks null-useMemo setup path in vitest config; triage failures; make npm run ci blocking in CI

Title: No CI workflow
Evidence: .github/workflows/ contains only render-deploy.yml; README badge points to ci.yml which does not exist
Impact: PRs merge without lint/type/test/build gate; deploy fires on every push to main
Recommended Fix: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml running npm run ci + lint + npm audit --audit-level=high; require passing for merge

Title: packWorker _failJob duplicate status column in UPDATE
Evidence: api/services/packWorker.ts:256-271 — SET status=$1, error_text=$2, status=$3, ...
Impact: PostgreSQL rejects the UPDATE; failures are swallowed by outer catch; jobs stuck in 'running' until timeout reclaim; never marked 'failed'
Recommended Fix: Remove duplicate status clause; write a test that exercises 3+ failures and asserts terminal status='failed'

Title: No systems/subsystems/tag-equipment register tables
Evidence: Review of api/db/migrations/001-025*.sql finds no such tables
Impact: Pack generation keys off a system_type varchar + synthetic asset — no tag-by-tag coverage matrix or traceability
Recommended Fix: Add systems, subsystems, equipment_tags tables with tenant/project FKs; link commissioning_packs.equipment_tag_id; add seed data

Title: No backend turnover/dossier persistence
Evidence: CxTurnoverItem is a client-side TypeScript type in src/modules/commissioning/rules.ts; no turnover_packages or dossiers table in DB
Impact: Project handover deliverable cannot be produced or audited from the DB
Recommended Fix: Add turnover_packages + dossier_items tables; wire CxWorkflowView Turnover tab to them

Title: ESLint fails with 157 parsing errors
Evidence: Reproduced via npm run lint — 'Parsing error: Unexpected token interface' on every .ts file
Impact: Lint claim in README is false; noUnused and consistent-style rules are unenforced
Recommended Fix: Wire @typescript-eslint/parser + parserOptions.project into eslint.config.js; add lint to CI

Title: 7 high-severity npm vulnerabilities
Evidence: npm audit reports undici HTTP smuggling/CRLF/WebSocket overflow (6 advisories) + picomatch ReDoS (2 advisories) + 2 moderate
Impact: Untrusted upstream responses could crash server; ReDoS via crafted glob patterns
Recommended Fix: npm audit fix; pin transitives if non-breaking; re-run CI

Title: Monolith-size ratchet at 6530 for a 1127-line file
Evidence: scripts/check-monolith-size.js MAX_LINES=6_530; actual JarvisCore.jsx = 1127 lines
Impact: Extraction progress invisible to CI; any regression up to 5400 lines would pass
Recommended Fix: Lower ratchet to 1150 (current + small buffer); add to CI

Title: RAG citations self-reported by the model (not validated)
Evidence: api/services/askBuilder.ts:232-237 — structured = toolUse.input as StructuredAnswer with no post-validation
Impact: A misbehaving model could fabricate a chunk_id that didn't appear in retrieved_chunks; UI shows false citation
Recommended Fix: Validate every citations[].chunk_id appears in retrieved_chunks; drop or flag unverified citations

Title: DB SSL uses rejectUnauthorized:false
Evidence: api/db/pool.ts:32,40
Impact: MITM risk for cloud-hosted DB traffic
Recommended Fix: Set rejectUnauthorized:true when DB_SSL=true; ship CA bundle or use system store

Title: Every tenantQuery wraps SELECT in BEGIN/COMMIT
Evidence: api/db/pool.ts:104-127
Impact: Per-request transaction overhead caps real throughput
Recommended Fix: Use SET LOCAL on the same connection without explicit BEGIN for read-only paths; or use server-side session variables

Title: Only global rate limits (no per-tenant)
Evidence: api/server.ts:156-162
Impact: Noisy-neighbor risk — one tenant can exhaust AI limit for all tenants
Recommended Fix: Key rate limiter by tenantId (or tenant+IP); adjust aiLimiter to per-tenant

Title: File download uses synchronous fs calls
Evidence: api/routes/files.ts:241-255 uses fs.existsSync / readFileSync per request
Impact: Event-loop blocking under concurrent downloads
Recommended Fix: Replace with fs.promises.access + streaming read

Title: CommissioningView reads closeouts/punch/lessons from Zustand only
Evidence: src/components/CommissioningView.tsx:11-18 imports selectPunchItems from biz store only
Impact: Numbers shown do not reconcile with backend punch_lists/punch_items
Recommended Fix: Reroute selectors through backend API where tables exist; keep Zustand as cache only

Title: Dev-only JWT fallback string
Evidence: api/auth.ts:40 JWT_SECRET fallback = '__dev-only-insecure-fallback__'
Impact: If NODE_ENV != production and JWT_SECRET unset, tokens can be forged by anyone with source access
Recommended Fix: Fail fast in non-production if JWT_SECRET unset — do not silently fall back

Title: README CI badge points at non-existent workflow
Evidence: README.md:5 badge URL .../workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg
Impact: Contributors and stakeholders believe CI exists; it doesn't
Recommended Fix: Either add ci.yml (F03) or remove the badge

Title: api/{db/{migrations...} literal-glob directory exists
Evidence: ls api/ shows '{db' as a real subdirectory — artifact of unquoted mkdir
Impact: Cosmetic but suggests a broken setup script shipped once
Recommended Fix: rm -rf the tree; check scripts for unquoted brace expansion

Title: App.jsx comment says JarvisCore ~6479 lines
Evidence: src/App.jsx:6-12 comment vs actual 1127 lines
Impact: Misleading about architectural state
Recommended Fix: Update or delete the comment — living comments describe invariants not snapshots

Title: http_fetch MCP tool: empty allowlist = open in dev
Evidence: .env.example:110 — "Empty = open in dev"
Impact: Agent can fetch arbitrary URLs in a dev env exposed to internet
Recommended Fix: Make empty allowlist mean deny in all envs; require explicit wildcard for open

Title: Pack /download/:format trusts stored path without bound check
Evidence: api/routes/commissioning.ts:403-418 reads row.path from DB via fs.readFile
Impact: If attacker can write commissioning_packs.markdown_path they can read files outside cx-packs dir
Recommended Fix: Validate path resolves inside STORAGE_DIR using path.resolve + prefix check

Title: Folder creation doesn't verify parent belongs to same project
Evidence: api/routes/files.ts:376-401 looks up parent_id without project_id match
Impact: Users can create folders under parents from other projects within same tenant
Recommended Fix: Add AND (project_id = $x OR project_id IS NULL) when looking up parent

Title: 125 TODO/FIXME markers in src/
Evidence: Grep count across src/
Impact: Backlog visibility; some placeholders for real features
Recommended Fix: Triage into an issues list; delete stale ones

Title: CHANGELOG references v4.32.0 while package.json is v4.30.0
Evidence: api/server.ts imports inspectionsRouter labeled // v4.32.0; package.json version = 4.30.0
Impact: Version labels are aspirational
Recommended Fix: Reconcile at next release

Title: Minified single-letter variables in JarvisCore.jsx
Evidence: src/jarvis/JarvisCore.jsx:79-84 — useState as g, useEffect as ui, etc.
Impact: Readability hostile for new contributors
Recommended Fix: Rename to semantic aliases during next extraction pass
